summary: Iteration 7 — verified the admin mission Save bug fix and the full removal of the Audit & Correction panel. 8/8 backend pytest tests pass; full Playwright UI flow for /(admin)/missions confirmed window.alert messages for empty title, valid save, and empty duration; mission is created, listed in the row list and deleted successfully. Audit endpoints all return 404 and the admin-open-audit button + 'Audit & Correction' label are absent from the admin dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>2800 lines) — would benefit from splitting (admin, payments, settings, withdrawals into separate routers).
Frontend (admin)/index.tsx is also very large (>1200 lines) — splitting into per-tab components would improve maintainability.
missions.tsx save() correctly coerces empty strings before sending (parseInt/parseFloat with isFinite guard) — robust fix for the 422 Pydantic error reported by the user.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_UI_Mission_Iter7 + TEST_Iter7 mission during test, no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend audit module fully removed; mission CRUD bug fixed via frontend coercion + window.alert. Regression test for manual upgrade (level≥2) NOT executed because creating a non-admin test user with sufficient balance_upgrade would require seeding — left to main agent if needed; nothing in the code path changed for that flow this iteration.
